Manufacturing & Processing

Precision-crafted textiles from the heart of India's textile hubs.

Our Facilities

Our Manufacturing & Processing Facilities

At Velciano Group, our manufacturing units are located in major textile hubs of India, enabling direct sourcing of premium fabrics and efficient production cycles.

Our state-of-the-art infrastructure ensures every product meets rigorous international quality standards, while our commitment to sustainability drives continuous improvements in our processes.

What Sets Us Apart

Key Features

Strategic Location

Access to high-quality raw materials and cost-effective production from major textile hubs of India.

Advanced Infrastructure

Modern machinery for weaving, stitching, dyeing, and finishing to meet global standards.

Sustainable Practices

Eco-friendly dyes, energy-efficient processes, and responsible waste management systems.

Customized Packaging

Bulk Export Cartons, Private Label Packaging, Barcode Labeling, and Custom Inserts — ensuring safe and professional global delivery.

Zero Compromise

Quality Control & Assurance

Every product that leaves our facility passes through rigorous multi-stage quality inspections, ensuring consistent excellence from raw material to finished textile.

01

Raw Material Inspection

Fabric density, thread count, and dye quality verified before production.

02

In-Process Checks

Continuous monitoring across weaving, stitching, and dyeing stages.

03

Final Inspection

Dimensional accuracy, color fastness, and finish quality verified before dispatch.

04

International Standards

Products certified for ISO, OEKO-TEX, and export-market compliance.
